name: claude-history
description: Local web browser for all Claude Code conversations across all projects

scripts.stop: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 7433 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force; Write-Host ('claude-history stopped (pid ' + $_ + ')') }"
